description: An enterprise-grade, contactless attendance system powered by Laravel, React, and Python facial recognition for seamless ESP32-CAM hardware integration.
longDescription: SmartAttend is a sophisticated, enterprise-ready attendance management platform designed for modern organizations. It combines a robust Laravel 12 backend with a dynamic React 19 (Inertia.js V2) frontend, Dockerized deployment, and an integrated Python Face Recognition Service to streamline HR operations. Designed for seamless integration with ESP32-CAM devices for contactless, facial recognition-based attendance.
features: Face Recognition: Contactless attendance via ESP32-CAM and a Python (Dlib) engine.
Auto-Enrollment & Sync: Instant face data setup with real-time, zero-restart synchronization.
Smart Directory: Full CRUD management for students, employees, teachers, and admins.
Attendance & Requests: Real-time status tracking alongside streamlined leave and remote work workflows.
HR Announcements: Targeted internal broadcasting system with variable priority levels.
Interactive Dashboards: Visual, real-time charts tracking weekly attendance trends.
AI Analyst: Automated, deep-dive textual attendance reports powered by Gemini AI.
Granular RBAC: Multi-tiered access control for Admins, Teachers, and Employees via Spatie.
Flexible Settings: Customizable schedules, late thresholds, and bilingual support (English/Indonesian).

description: An automated, IoT-enabled fish feeder designed for aquariums. Features precise feeding controls and a modern aesthetic.
longDescription: An automated, web-controlled fish feeder powered by a Wemos D1 Mini (ESP8266), an RTC module (DS3231 or DS1307), and a servo motor.
features: Premium Web Interface: A beautifully designed, mobile-responsive dashboard with a dark, glassmorphic UI, real-time logging, and system health status.
Dual Mode WiFi (AP + Station): The device broadcasts its own Access Point (FishFeeder_AP) to ensure you're never locked out, while simultaneously connecting to your home network.
Asynchronous WiFi Scanning: Easily find and connect to your home network using the built-in WiFi scanner and dropdown selector.
Dynamic Configuration: Set a daily automated feeding schedule and manage network credentials directly from the settings panel. Configurations are safely saved to the LittleFS filesystem.
Time Synchronization: Synchronize the integrated RTC clock seamlessly with your browser's time via the Web Interface with a single click.
Hardware Health Monitoring: Real-time visibility into RTC operational status and system errors directly on the dashboard.
Precision Feeding: Explicit 0-180 degree servo sweep ensures a full dispense during every feeding cycle.

description: Modular post-installation automation script for Fedora and Ubuntu with an interactive Charm Gum TUI, developer runtimes, and system configurations.
longDescription: A shell-based post-installation automation suite for Fedora Workstation and Ubuntu (GNOME/KDE). It streamlines OS setup through an interactive terminal interface (Charm Gum), installing essential development runtimes (fnm, uv, Docker, Go, Rust), configuring a customized Zsh and Starship environment, applying system codecs and VA-API hardware acceleration, and handling ASUS laptop hardware profiles (asusctl/supergfxctl).
features: Interactive Terminal UI: Modular menu system built with Charm Gum, featuring multi-select options, progress feedback, and bilingual support (EN/ID).
Curated Setup Profiles: One-shot installation presets for Minimal Developer, Full Workstation, Gaming & Creator, and ASUS ROG/TUF hardware.
Modern Dev Runtimes: Installs and configures fnm (Node.js), uv (Python), rustup, Go, OpenJDK, and Docker Engine without manual repository setup.
Shell & CLI Configuration: Configures Zsh with Starship prompt, Nerd Fonts, and modern CLI tools (eza, zoxide, bat, fastfetch).
ASUS ROG/TUF Integration: Manages dedicated Linux laptop controls including asusctl, GPU switching via supergfxctl, and battery charge thresholds.
Safety & System Recovery: Automated Btrfs/Timeshift snapshot triggers before heavy package execution, with full logging to ~/.cache.

description: Interactive TUI and automation utility for fresh Windows 10/11 setups, featuring batch Winget app installations, debloating, and PowerShell tuning.
longDescription: A Python and PowerShell automation tool designed to set up fresh Windows 10 and 11 environments quickly. Executable via a single-line PowerShell bootstrap without pre-installed Git, it provides an interactive TUI to batch-install software through Winget, remove pre-installed UWP bloatware, apply reversible registry and Explorer tweaks, and configure modern PowerShell with PSReadLine IntelliSense and Starship.
features: One-Line Bootstrap: Runs directly from an elevated PowerShell command without requiring Git or pre-installed dependencies.
Winget Batch Installer: Interactive multi-select TUI powered by Python and Rich, backed by an editable catalog (apps.json) and persona presets.
PowerShell & Terminal Tuning: Automatically sets up PSReadLine predictive IntelliSense, Starship prompt, and standard Unix-like CLI aliases.
UWP Package Debloater: Selectively removes unnecessary pre-installed Windows UWP apps and telemetry services.
Reversible System Tweaks: Applies practical Windows UX adjustments (classic context menu, show extensions, taskbar end-task) with automatic registry backups and 1-click rollback.
Pre-Flight Diagnostics & Migration: Checks disk headroom, administrator privileges, and Winget connectivity; exports and imports setup configurations across machines.

description: A modern native Android wedding preparation manager built with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose (M3), Clean Architecture, and Supabase cloud sync.
longDescription: Wed Planner is an offline-first native Android application engineered with Kotlin, Jetpack Compose (Material 3), and Clean Architecture. Features instant Room SQLite local transactions with asynchronous Supabase cloud sync, SHA-256 Content-Addressable Storage (CAS) for photo moodboards, and native PDF/CSV document export.
features: Offline-First Clean Architecture: Instant local Room SQLite transactions with background Supabase REST API cloud sync.
Jetpack Compose M3 UI: Modern native Android interface featuring Material You dynamic colors and Home Screen Widgets.
Content-Addressable Storage (CAS): SHA-256 hash-based photo management preventing duplicate disk & cloud storage.
Budget & Vendor Tracking: Multi-event budget calculation with payment milestones and linked vendor notes.
Native PDF & CSV Export: Built-in document export engine using Android PdfDocument Canvas API.

description: A cinematic, responsive wedding invitation website featuring micro-animations, calligraphy text reveals, and glowing UI elements.
longDescription: This project leverages modern frontend technologies combined with a lightweight, serverless backend approach, Frontend: Svelte + TypeScript built with Vite, Styling: Tailwind CSS for responsive and highly customizable UI, Backend/Database: Google Apps Script serving as a REST API to read/write data to a Google Sheet.
features: Ethereal & Romantic Design: Premium floating floral accents, sophisticated typography, and soft palettes crafted for modern weddings.
Fluid Animations: Scroll-driven fade-ins, falling petals, and smooth page transitions.
Headless Google Sheets CMS: Update names, dates, quotes, events, and RSVP data simply by editing a spreadsheet.
Smart Image Parsing: Automatically converts generic Google Drive shareable links into direct-view thumbnails for your gallery.
Live RSVP Management: Fully functioning RSVP submission form that securely posts incoming guest data directly back to your designated Google Sheet tab.
Atmospheric Audio: Built-in background music player with elegant UI controls.
